name: lean_wall
text: A person rests their lower back and hips against the vertical wall behind them in a relaxed slightly bent-knee standing posture. Feet are planted slightly in front of the hips. The upper back, neck and head stay gently inclined forward away from the wall. Both arms hang quietly down, shoulders relaxed. Hold this comfortable supported posture with slight breathing only. Do not sit, fall, gesture, reach, straighten the neck backward or move the feet.
